scope.timing_note: TPOT speedup = heuristic TPOT / policy TPOT; reduction_pct = 100*(1 - 1/speedup). Do not call 1.813x an 81.3% reduction.
scope.audit_execution: read-only CSV/JSON/JSONL inspection and stdlib arithmetic; no verify, pytest, pip, GPU experiments. verify delegated to root.

conditions.limitation: manifest git.status is nonempty, so these were not measured on a clean commit; one scenario per condition.

ragged_fixed8_outlier.cause: unknown; no evidence of another GPU process in monitoring; do not silently exclude

criteria.rule: most steps with predicted regret >= regret at batch >= min_batch, among windows whose capped replay mean batch >= min_batch

prediction.claim: surrogate prediction (GPU-free replay, 30 ms constant step, instantaneous prefill); not a measurement

conditions.prompt_kind: seeded random tokens; source trace provides lengths only
conditions.selection_bias: 382 windows searched, 17 met average batch >=26; selected highest predicted problem count, not random representative window
conditions.policy_cache: keep, cache initially empty in repeat 0; repeats 1 and 2 have seen the same trace

old_backend_audit.source: vllm_4090/logs/vllm_reproduce*.log of the 2026-10-06 reproduction (scripts/vllm_reproduce.py sets VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND)

limitations: Do not use original summary median columns: forward and sampling iterations were mixed. Corrected row aggregation is required.
All engine_reported_backend fields in manifest are null due to mismatching log regex. Actual backend established by kernel names and source host logs.
Attention dominates mixed vs uniform difference; split heuristic as the direct cause in vLLM has not been isolated.
FA2 wrapper accepts num_splits 0/1 only, so external split selection was not implemented/measured in vLLM.
Do not report 81 -> 31 ms as achieved: it is a hypothetical extrapolation.

conditions.text: six-paragraph Campus Garden corpus repeated to exact length, not a real 64K source document

conditions.decode: greedy, 256 generated tokens per request, no EOS stopping
conditions.marker_metric: post hoc choice of first number after ####, mandatory disclosure
conditions.prespecified_metric: last number before stop marker, retained for transparency
conditions.limitation: policy comparison only, not an official model GSM8K score; equal accuracy does not establish no quality change

verify_mapping_note: Most displayed numbers are already covered by verify prefixes. Exact literal key inventory below is extracted statically, not executed. Generated comprehension keys are described in per-table fields.
recommended_main_text: GPU 프로파일링과 시뮬레이션 분석을 통해 혼합 길이 디코드 배치의 부하 불균형 및 정적 설정의 한계를 관측하고, 실측 테이블과 보정된 대리 성능 모델로 매 단계의 KV 분할 수를 선택하여 TPOT을 줄였다. 사이클 시뮬레이터는 원인 설명과 민감도 분석에 사용했으며, Accel-Sim의 절대 시간 보정 완료 또는 새로운 GPU 스케줄러 구현을 주장하지 않는다.
